'''Birdie''' is a leader of [[Vault 4]] refugees in [[Timeline (2250-2300)#2296|2296]] {{In|FOTV}}. She is the assistant of the [[overseer]] [[Benjamin (TV series)|Benjamin]].

==Background==
She claims that she was born on the surface and comes from [[Shady Sands]]. Her mother was a courier, and when she was 11, she traveled with her mother to [[Filly]]. 

When her hometown was nuked by [[Hank MacLean]] in 2283, Birdie could feel the heat of the blast from Shady Sands across the region. She eventually made her way to Vault 4, where other survivors of Shady Sands would live. Over time, she evidently became something of an authority figure for the Shady Sands refugees in Vault 4, leading them in cult-like rituals to honor their lost hometown and venerate the "[[Lee Moldaver|Flame Mother]]" as someone who can restore what they have lost.

==''Fallout'' TV series==
===[[The Trap]]===
Birdie welcomes [[Lucy MacLean]] and [[Maximus]] when they find themselves in Vault 4, explaining how they will receive medical examinations before being allowed inside the vault. She catches Maximus by the Vault's reactor and offers him a [[Pip-Boy 3000 Mark V|Pip-Boy]] that also serves as a key to a room he could stay in. Later, she leads a ritual with the other Shady Sands survivors in honor of their lost hometown and Lee Moldaver, before later arriving at level 12 to confront Lucy after she was caught there despite told not to go there.

===[[The Radio]]===
Birdie and Ben interrogate Lucy after she is caught sneaking around the restricted area. Birdie explains to Lucy how the Vault is trying to find cures to alleviate the suffering of those who were experimented upon by the original leaders.

==Personality==
Birdie is shown to usually have a calm and serious demeanor, as seen when talking to Lucy when welcoming her and Maximus to Vault 4. She retains her regular attitude even after she catches Lucy breaking the rules by trespassing on Level 12, despite showing disappointment and some anger over Lucy entering Level 12. She never breaks her calm demeanor even when revealing the troubled past of Vault 4 by explaining how its original overseers of Vault 4 experimented on its inhabitants, and accusing Lucy of being associated with Vault-Tec.
